2:1.sourceText: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία Πνεύματος, εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί,

unmappedTarget.reason: English copula supplied in a Greek verbless clause; no corresponding finite Greek verb.
Bracketed English article supplied before anarthrous Πνεύματος.

2:2.sourceText: πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε, τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες, σύνψυχοι, τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες,

unmappedSource.reason: Greek article is not separately rendered in this English possessive or proper-name phrase.

2:3.sourceText: μηδὲν κατ’ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν, ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν,
2:3.targetText: nothing in rivalry or vainglory, but in humility of mind counting one another more excellent than yourselves—

review.note: Repeated κατ’ … κατά governs the coordinated rivalry/vainglory nouns, rendered once by English in; both actual preposition tokens share that one phrase. τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ is the dative constituent in humility of mind.

2:4.sourceText: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι.
2:4.targetText: do not each look to your own, but each also to the things of others.

review.note: The single look-to construction governs both coordinated objects. The repeated English to in the elliptical second limb remains attached to σκοποῦντες, not to an unrelated Greek function word.

2:5.sourceText: τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

2:18.sourceText: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ καὶ ὑμεῖς χαίρετε καὶ συνχαίρετέ μοι.
2:18.targetText: because of this you also rejoice and are glad with me.

groups.note: LSV gives the short substantival τὸ αὐτό a causal rendering, because of this (compare KJV the same cause); the whole constituent is linked, without assigning because individually to an article or pronoun. The unexpressed δέ connective is recorded separately.

unmappedSource.reason: N1904 δέ is a coordinating/contrastive connective (and/but); LSV has no separately expressed counterpart. Its causal because of this renders τὸ αὐτό as one interpretive constituent, not δέ as a causal conjunction.

review.note: LSV gives a causal rendering of the short adverbial constituent τὸ δὲ αὐτό (normally likewise/in the same way; KJV for the same cause). The complete constituent is paired, without assigning because or of individually to an article or pronoun.
